transmission_chain.rationale: This deterministic chain starts from the event's own supply-chain nodes (first-order) and expands to second-order affected nodes only when they recur across at least 2 independent retrieved historical analogs, so that single-case co-occurrence is not treated as sufficient evidence. The transmission narrative and the supporting-case list are scoped to the cases that actually support an accepted node, so the presented story matches the nodes that were accepted.
